description:
Create Gift Bags Customers and Clients Will Love to Receive

When sending gifts to customers or providing them bags for their holiday purchases, the packaging is as important as the present itself. Create gift bags that will liven up the season and act as an effective promotional tool. The overall design should showcase your brand while also keeping the gift safe and presentable. Perfect not only for customers but also for businesses that are sending out corporate Christmas bags to clients and collaborators.  

 

Customize every detail from the enhanced print to the combination of the bag and handle’s colors for recipients to remember your brand. Here’s how you can do it with the features available on UPrinting.

 

How to Create a Charming Set of Custom Gift Bags for Every Occasion

Custom-printed gift bags come in a variety of styles and sizes. Print several designs for your holiday line or as special packages for your clients and staff. Make sure every detail matches, from the logo outside and in your customized gift items. You can gift several exclusive product lines or branded items like flash drives and chargers for corporate presents. 

 

A Variety of Sizes for an Assortment of Items

Choose the dimensions according to the size, number, and weight of the items that will be stowed in small to large gift bags:  

  • Mini Bags (3'' W x 2'' D x 4" H) – These petite bags are great for small party favors, jewelry, or gift cards. They are handy, especially when you don’t want to wrap small items one by one.
  • Square Bags (5.25" W x 3" D x 5.25" H) – These party bags are just the right size for marketing swag. Perfect for putting together promotional materials such as playing cards and pocket notes to give away at trade shows and other events.
  • Small Gift Bags (5" W x 3" D x 8.5" H) – Slightly taller than party bags, small gift bags also make excellent goody bags for parties and marketing events. Use these bags to hold mugs, portable chargers, and more. 
  • Wine Bags (5.5" W x 4" D x 14" H) – Make wine bottles look more presentable and easier to carry with wine bags. These custom-printed gift bags can house standard wine bottles.
  • Medium Gift Bag (7" W x 4.5" D x 10" H) – These custom paper bags with handles have ample space to store bigger items for marketing. Notebooks, mugs, or caps can fit in this medium-sized gift bag. 
  • Large Gift Bag (12.5" W x 4" D x 9" H) – This is the largest of all our offerings. Long and spacious, these can serve as custom luxury shopping bags for shoes, clothing, and other big items. 

 

Elevate the look of your logo or company name with a reflective gloss finish or an elegant matte laminate.  

  • Gloss is perfect for bold and bright color combinations. Recommended for holiday Christmas bags or special designs printed for your VIP customers. 
  • Matte provides an elegant and understated finish that suits pastel, light, or neutral colors. It has almost no glare, making it perfect for designs that have your company motto or detailed information like your locations included. It’s also a great alternative to the usual bold and festive colors during the holidays.  

 

Add your artwork anywhere on the external part of the bag, including the gusset. With full-color printing, you can print in any color that reflects your brand. Several handle colors are available to complement the bag’s entire look: from black, white, green, to red, orange, and blue.

 

Personalize Giveaways for Special Events 

You could also create custom gift bags for special events like conferences or exhibitions. It’s an affordable yet personalized way to have attendees sample your products and experience what your company has to offer.  Here are some items that your potential customer won’t want to throw away: 

Sticky Notepads

T-shirts

Custom Pen

Keychains

Drink Ware


 

Gift Bags FAQs

What is the heaviest weight or items the bags can hold? 

A wine bag with the size 5.5” W x 4” D x 14” H is available. This can carry the slightly heavier weight of a wine bottle.  

 

Can I print it on the inside of the gift bag? 

No, only outside printing is available. If you require a custom printing order, check out the options here.  

 

What are the dimensions available for large gift bags? 

The largest size available is at 12.5” W x 4” D x 9” H. The expansive width offers enough space for several items of clothing, shoes, and other bulk products.  

 

 

What are the requirements for an uploaded gift bag artwork or file? 

Refer to the list below to ensure your submitted file is print-ready and will require little to no changes before production: 

  • Accepted file formats: PDF, AI, TIF, TIFF, PUB, JPG, PSD, JPEG, and PNG. 
  • 300 dpi resolution  
  • CMYK color tone 
  • 0.125” bleed on each side  

 

 

Will I save more if I order the gift bags in bulk?  

Yes, the larger your order quantity, the less you spend per piece. The online calculator will show both the total and unit cost.
